notes.subject: man
notes.rationale: מחריד is a participle 'one who frightens away'; Tok Pisin needs the noun ⟨man⟩ supplied

notes.subject: raitim ol i go
notes.rationale: מחריד rare verb: 'frighten/terrify away' — versions split between 'fray away', 'frighten', 'trouble'

notes.subject: bodi bilong man i dai
notes.rationale: נבלת is 'carrion, flabby corpse' — one word in Hebrew, picture of unburied rot

translation: Na ol bodi bilong ol manmeri bilong dispela lain bai i kamap kaikai bilong ol pisin bilong skai, na bilong ol animal bilong graun, na i no gat ⟨man⟩ i raitim ol i go.

tokens.gloss: ol bodi bilong man i dai
na bilong ol animal bilong lukautim
man i raitim ol i go
